approvedBy: Claude editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-28
firstPlayerRule: The younger player goes first. Players then alternate turns asking a YES or NO question.
houseFallback: This site's house-rule fallback is to pick randomly if the players are the same age.
clarifications: Each player first chooses a Mystery Character from their own tray before play begins.
For tournament-style Championship Play, the first player to win five games is the Champion.
internalEvidence: Fetched the publisher-hosted instruction-sheet PDF (Hasbro's kc-usercontent asset host, item 058010000) and extracted its text with pdftotext. "Playing The Game — The younger player goes first. Players alternate turns by asking a YES or NO question." The same page also documents "Championship Play" ("The first player to win five games is the Champion!") and a two-character "Challenge Game" variant, confirming this is the standard 2-player Guess Who? board edition, not a licensed theme variant.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for players of the same age.
